# 👋 Welcome to XGrammar[¶](https://xgrammar.mlc.ai#welcome-to-xgrammar)

XGrammar is open-source solution for flexible, portable, and fast structured generations. The mission of this project is to bring flexible zero-overhead structure generation everywhere.
